<!-- pr-reviewer: 07b0913999003a7cf1b32bb7656065cb86eb327e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (clean review; the PR is still a draft).

**What looks good**
- One translation point (`crates/post/src/post/invert.rs`, called from `engine::run_numbered_with` before `onOpen`). Every caller (GUI `posting.rs:343`, per-op `posting_per_op.rs:100`, CLI `post.rs:132`, scripting and MCP, which use the same engine) goes through it, and a refusal is a `PostError::Refused`, so nothing is written.
- Rules checked by hand in all three planes. G17: X xor Y flips the sense; both cancel. G18 (X,Z): only X counts, because Z is refused. G19 (Y,Z): only Y counts. Y inverted alone in G18 correctly does not swap, since the X/Z coordinates are untouched. I/J/K and the centre flip with their axis. G41/G42 swap when exactly one of X/Y is inverted. The arc centre is absolute in the record, so the scripts' `c.I - StartX` flips consistently.
- The equivalence reader (`inverted_support/mod.rs`) is independent of the translator. It builds arcs from I/J/K and the plane normal (Rodrigues) in controller coordinates. It maps to the physical frame as `sign*c + ORIGIN`, and derives the comp side from the travel and offset vectors. It asserts on G91, so an unmodelled word cannot slip through. `the_standard_program_on_an_inverted_machine_strays` shows it fails an untranslated program, so a wrong swap would be caught.
- The refusals cover everything the shipped Fanuc/Haas scripts could mishandle: helical, threading, A/B/C, live tooling, probing (including its G91/G10 paths), Z or any other letter, unflagged scripts, an unpaired stock edge, `"reversal": true`, and a garbled direction. Mill cycles are only G73/81/82/83/84/86/89, so there is no G76/G87 shift. The scripts have no G68, no R-form arcs and no G92. G28 X0 Y0 goes via the work origin, so it is mirror-safe.
- Existing goldens untouched (only `inverted/fanuc_x.nc` and `haas_x.nc` are added). The standard mirror emits no `invertedAxes`. No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests. `invert.rs` is 299 lines. Provenance lines are present. Body ends `Fixes #374` and has a `Changelog:` line. No CHANGELOG.md edit. No build.rs, `.github` or dependency changes.

**Local results (merged with origin/main: already up to date, no conflicts)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| build post + app tests | ok |
| post: post_engine 33, comp 9, axis_direction_cli 3 | pass |
| app: inverted_post 15, inverted_equivalence 2, axis_direction 12, posting 17, conformance 6, golden_cl 23, fanuc_post 8, machine 32, control_comp 5, wear_comp 5 | pass |
| clippy -D warnings, post + app + ui, all targets | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Cutter compensation swaps G41/G42 on the XY rule even if a G18/G19 plane is modal. That is #391 (pre-existing); it is wrong with or without inversion, so fixing #391 covers both.
2. The reader skips G28 lines and the G10/G91 probe paths. This is fine today because probing is refused and G28 is mirror-invariant. If a script ever adds a G28 with a non-zero X/Y intermediate, the translator and reader will need extending.
3. `inverted_axes()` ignores rotary axes. This is safe now because any tilted move or live tooling is refused, but a future rotary positioning record without `abc` would need a look.
4. The machine editor note was not exercised in the GUI (the author states the same).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
